<!--
  Open jobs as cards in two columns, grouped by department, or as a table: the title, the department, the place,
  the type, an optional salary and an apply link. Axes: layout (grid, grouped, table), salary (show, hide),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Job, Department, JobLabels } from "./job-board.types";

export type JobBoardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  jobs: Job[];
  departments: Department[];
  labels: JobLabels;
  layout?: "grid" | "grouped" | "table";
  salary?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import JobCards from "../components/job-cards.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  jobs,
  departments,
  labels,
  layout = "grid",
  salary = "hide",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<JobBoardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    density="default"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'grouped') ? '3xl' : 'default')"
  >
    <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'grouped')" gap="8" align="stretch" data-testid="groups">
      <Stack v-for="d in departments" :key="d.id" gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="group">
        <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
          <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
            {{ d.name }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(labels.count, (jobs.filter((i) => !d.id || i["dept"] === d.id)?.length ?? 0)) }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
          <ListItem v-for="j in jobs.filter((i) => !d.id || i['dept'] === d.id)" :key="j.id"
            class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-4"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Link href="#/careers" variant="default" class="font-medium">
                {{ j.title }}
              </Link>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ tpl("{0}, {1}", j.location, j.type) }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <Badge variant="outline" size="default">
              {{ j.type }}
            </Badge>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <JobCards v-else :jobs="jobs" :departments="departments" :labels="labels" :layout="layout" :salary="salary" />
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
